parsed.name: STAR Chatterbox 模拟后端
parsed.description: 这是一个面向 Hamilton STAR 液体处理平台的非实体模拟组件。它通过返回虚拟机器配置、吸头状态、96头固件信息、iSWAP 状态与位置等数据，并模拟通道及 iSWAP 运动，用于开发、调试、命令测试和流程验证，而非直接驱动真实仪器。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical simulation component for the Hamilton STAR liquid handling platform. It provides mock machine configuration, tip status, 96-head firmware data, iSWAP status and positions, and simulated channel and iSWAP motion for development, debugging, command testing, and workflow validation rather than direct control of real hardware.
